info.title: Business Events
info.description:
Every business event Extole's v10 component library ships, as a callable operation. Each is an **Action** in the sense this section uses: submitting one changes state in a program.

Names, display names and descriptions come from `business-events-list` in `extole/creative`; the request and response bodies are the platform's own `EventSubmissionData` and `EventDispatcherResponse` from the published Server to Extole bundle.

**Preview for the ENG-30863 design review, not a merge candidate.** Generated from the component inventory to show this section at full scale; no component declares `operations[]` yet.
